name: ryu.brave
description: Independent web search via the Brave Search API (https://brave.com/search/api/), exposed as one declarative HTTP tool. Provides the swappable `web.search` layer, so selecting it in the layer picker re-points the stable `web.search` tool at Brave's own crawled index without changing what agents call. Brave is search-only: it deliberately declares neither `web.extract` nor `web.crawl`. Requires a BYOK Brave Search API key.
